name: 92337 · Fontana, CA
findings: ZIP 92337 (Fontana) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (22%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92337 (Fontana) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92337 (Fontana) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.
